# iLoveIMG

> > The fastest free web app for easy image modification, compression, conversion, and editing with batch processing and cloud integration.

iLoveIMG is a Barcelona-based online image editing platform founded in 2010 that provides free tools for image manipulation without requiring software installation. The platform supports batch processing, cloud storage integration (Google Drive, Dropbox), and AI-powered features like background removal and image upscaling.

## Key Topics

- Batch processing
- Image compression
- Image conversion
- Cloud integration
- AI upscaling
- Background removal
- JPG/PNG/GIF formats
- Online editor
- Free tools
- Image cropping
- Watermarking
- Photo editing
- HTML to image
- Google Drive
- Dropbox

## Core Image Editing Tools

- [iLoveIMG | The fastest free web app for easy image modification.](https://www.iloveimg.com): iLoveIMG homepage: free web app for image editing, compression, conversion
- [Free Online Photo Editor. Edit photo quick and easy.](https://www.iloveimg.com/photo-editor): Free photo editor with text, stickers, filters, effects, framing
- [Crop your images in seconds for free!](https://www.iloveimg.com/crop-image): Crop JPG, PNG, GIF images with Google Drive integration support
- [Rotate images in seconds for free!](https://www.iloveimg.com/rotate-image): Rotate JPG, PNG, GIF images with batch processing and cloud support
- [Watermark your images. Stamp multiple pictures at once.](https://www.iloveimg.com/watermark-image): Batch watermark JPG, PNG, GIF images with text or image stamps
- [Blur face - Anonymize, pixelate and protect images](https://www.iloveimg.com/blur-face): Blur faces and anonymize images for privacy protection online

## Image Optimization & Processing

- [Easily compress images at optimal quality in seconds.](https://www.iloveimg.com/compress-image): Compress JPG, PNG, GIF, SVG images with batch processing capability
- [Resize multiple images at once!](https://www.iloveimg.com/resize-image): Bulk resize JPG, PNG, SVG, GIF images by pixels or percentages
- [Free AI Image Upscaling Tool - Increase resolution of your images](https://www.iloveimg.com/upscale-image): AI-powered image upscaling tool to enhance resolution and quality
- [Image background remover](https://www.iloveimg.com/remove-background): AI-powered background remover for JPG, PNG with cloud integration

## Image Conversion & Format Tools

- [Convert images in multiple formats to JPG in seconds.](https://www.iloveimg.com/convert-to-jpg): Batch convert PNG, GIF, TIFF, PSD formats to JPG online
- [Convert JPG images to PNG or make animated GIFs for free!](https://www.iloveimg.com/jpg-to-image): Convert JPG to PNG, GIF, or animated GIF formats in seconds
- [HTML to Image converter. Transform HTML pages into an image.](https://www.iloveimg.com/html-to-image): Convert HTML pages to JPG or SVG image formats online

## Creative Tools

- [Meme generator. Create the funniest memes online.](https://www.iloveimg.com/meme-generator): Free meme creator with text overlay and font customization
